Subject: E-sign + order form: next steps for Coupa registration

Hi Sana — great to meet yesterday. Thanks for moving this forward. Two quick coordination asks as we start vendor registration in Coupa: 

1) MSA redline & e-sign: we've got your signed MSA draft (thanks). Legal (Kimberly) will take a quick pass on the redlines you uploaded. Can you confirm whether your legal team prefers DocuSign in the Coupa workflow or an emailed DocuSign execution outside of Coupa? We need to confirm evidence for our audit (certificate of completion).

2) Order Form PO-field gating: our ops team needs to confirm the exact PO field set Medisys will populate in Coupa so we can map to our PO-ack and invoicing flows. Key fields we need: buyer PO number (PO#), line-level GL code, remit-to address, invoice-to contact email, and a field for "Billing SLA / Net terms". If any of these are optional on your side, flag which ones might be missing so we can propose a fallback.

Cc'ing Kimberly (legal) and Mateo (ops) to loop them in; they will call out any redline must-haves or mapping blockers. Can we target a short call Friday to finalize?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Internal notes for sync — high-level legal guidance on the Medisys redline we received: 

1) E-sign evidence: DocuSign certificates + system logs are acceptable. Ask procurement to provide the certificate-of-completion PDF and a CSV export of the signing audit trail. We'll store those with the contract in our evidence bundle.

2) Indemnity/cap: their redline removes the liability cap carve for breach of confidentiality. We should push back: propose an exception limited to confirmed data-breach incidents where Medisys can prove their culpable control. Recommend mark-up: retain mutual cap with an exception narrowly drafted.

3) Data residency & logging: examples in the redline reference EU processing. For this deal (US region), propose we accept US-only processing commitments and require cross-border transfers to be limited with SCCs if EU data is involved.

4) Order Form signing path: prefer the Order Form to be executed via embedded DocuSign (Coupa) if they can provide automated certificate delivery to both parties. If they insist on emailed separate DocuSign, require a clause that Order Forms executed in either flow are valid and link back to the MSA by ID.

Action items for Marissa / Mateo before we reply to Sana: 
- Confirm which execution path Medisys will use (embedded Coupa DocuSign vs standalone).
- If embedded, request the signing certificate sample and any SAML/SSO identity assertions they include in the audit export.
- Mateo to confirm whether missing optional fields can be tolerated or must be blocked at activation.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medisys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Sep 2027 14:41:00 -0700
Subject: PO field mapping and PO-ack gating for Coupa activation

Sana — thanks for the quick turnaround. Follow up from ops:

- Required PO fields for our activation and PO-ack mapping: PO#, line_number, item_sku, qty, unit_price, line_total, buyer_gl_segment, remit_to_address (normalized), invoice_contact_email.
- If buyer_gl_segment is not provided at line level we can accept header-level GL but that will require a manual mapping step on our side and delays to PO-ack. Please confirm whether you can enable line-level GL for our vendor profile.
- EDI vs API: we can accept PO via Coupa API push or SFTP EDI (ANSI X12 850). If you choose SFTP, we need hostname + SFTP account by activation.
- Invoice routing: we will match invoices by PO# + invoice number. Please ensure invoice emails include the PO# in the subject line to avoid queue misses.

Attached is a minimal PO schema example we use for integration. If Medisys can send a Coupa sample JSON or CSV with real field names, we'll map fields on our side and flag any missing ones.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min tech-check on Monday to align field mapping and confirm e-sign artifact delivery?

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment(s): po_schema_example.json (schema stub)

- For PO delivery we prefer Coupa API push. If you require SFTP/EDI we can provision an SFTP account; let us know preferred hostnames and we'll open a provisioning ticket.

Attachments: our signed-to-be Order Form (we will sign via embedded DocuSign) and a Coupa sample export. We are happy to do a tech-check call Monday 9/13 at 10am PT — please confirm.
